description_text: This is a brand name or equal solicitation for two Continental Two-Door Roll-In Refrigerators for Pittsburgh VAMC. Please carefully review Section E.1 Instructions to Offerors for quote requirements. This is an SDVOSB set-aside. Questions are due by Thursday, April 16th, at 12:00 PM Eastern to the POC's email. All responses are due by Thursday, April 23rd, at 12:00 PM Eastern.
